name: Plank Walkout
instructions: Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a full plank, keeping the core braced.
Walk the hands back to your feet and stand up. A dynamic core and hamstring mover.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Plank Walkout is a beginner core exercise targeting the abs, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
